# Medical Conditions

This folder groups diagnosed diseases and health conditions tracked within the Danish Acute Surgery Database. It currently focuses on life-threatening acute surgical emergencies that require immediate medical intervention, urgent antibiotic therapy, and strict adherence to national clinical performance indicators to optimize patient survival and prevent severe complications like sepsis.

## Pages

- [[entities/medical-conditions/acute-surgical/index|Acute Surgical]] — Life-threatening surgical emergencies such as ischemia, perforated hollow organs, and severe ileus that mandate rapid antibiotic administration and are monitored under national quality improvement initiatives.
